standard: SELECTION_CRITERIA.md Section 3; guide window >= 2024-09-16; reach floor >= 10,000; activity post >= 2026-06-18
two_signal_caveat_assessment: The council accepts the TikTok two-signal date method (video-ID decode + independent mirror/indexed caption) as sufficient for the guide-date criterion: the signals guard against misattribution and decode error, which are the realistic failure modes. The documented limitation — both signals ultimately derive from TikTok platform data — is noted and does not invalidate the 19 PASS verdicts, since no evidence of TikTok-side misreporting was found in any sampled case.
